purpose: Teach: 交信/逆説/マニフェスト/点在/入港/強者/待合室/首席

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、無線交信に苦労された
lines.en: When your father founded the company, he struggled hard with radio communications.
lines.style: Gentle, remembering voice. Soft attack on the opening. Warm nostalgia — not mournful, but honoring. Slow, deliberate pace. Breathing space between phrases, like he's letting each memory settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは逆説的経営判断もされた
lines.en: Yes. My father made paradoxical management decisions, but they were right.
lines.style: Measured and clear. Slight weight on 'paradoxical' — acknowledging the insight. Steady, not rushed. Conviction without performance. The tone of someone bearing witness to something true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業マニフェストを起草された
lines.en: Your father drafted the founding manifesto with his own hands.
lines.style: Wistful but not sad. Deliberate pacing. Eyes in the middle distance. The voice of someone honoring specifics — letting the detail speak for itself. Slight trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは販路を全国に点在させた
lines.en: Yes. He scattered sales channels across the entire country — no single point of failure.
lines.style: Thoughtful, explaining-to-understand-it-himself quality. Steady pace. Not lecturing. A son recognizing the architecture his father built. Clear, capable tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、輸入船の入港に自ら立ち会われた
lines.en: He would stand at the port himself when import ships came in.
lines.style: Wistful, almost tender. Light attack, then settling. The voice of someone watching the memory play out. Slow pace. Admiration without needing to name it. Quiet at the trailing edge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界の強者と対等に渡り合われた
lines.en: Yes. He held his own with the strongest in the industry — as an equal.
lines.style: Steady, grounded pride. Even pacing. No strain in the voice, just solid recognition of strength matched against strength. The respect of one who understands what it took.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お客様の待合室にも気を配られた
lines.en: He even took care with the customer waiting room — those small details mattered to him.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender. Slight wonder in the voice — delighted to remember something gentle from someone strong. Soft pace. The warmth of seeing a father's humanity through his care for strangers.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新入社員首席にも自ら声をかけられた
lines.en: Yes. He would greet new employees himself — even the one ranked first in their class.
lines.style: Wise, closing voice. Steady and kind. A light sense of resolution — the pattern is complete. No rush. The tone of someone who has understood something about his father through these moments and is letting it settle. Peaceful.
